notes: Engine wave W1 (KNOWLEDGE/2026-11-18/215, fault F14; a known bug, failing, until W1): a resolving ability names the object its source was when it was activated, so a source that changed zones since is not 'this Equipment' (CR 113.7a, 400.7). Printed: Colossus Hammer, 'Equipped creature gets +10/+10 and loses flying. Equip {8}' (Attach to target creature you control). Seat 0 activates equip targeting its Bear; while the ability waits, the Hammer is destroyed (a move by another effect) and Brought Back (verified, M20) returns it. The Hammer on the battlefield is a new object (CR 400.7) that the equip ability does not name (CR 113.7a, 701.3a): it stays unattached and the Bear stays a 2/2. Before W1 the ability attached the new Hammer, a 12/12 Bear, stronger than printed. The same holds for every Equip in the deal pools (M20: Ancestral Blade, Heart-Piercer Bow, Marauder's Axe, Mask of Immolation, Wolfrider's Saddle; M21: Short Sword, Malefic Scythe; FDN: Adventuring Gear, Fireshrieker, Goldvein Pick, Pirate's Cutlass), wherever the pool can return an artifact while the ability waits (M20: Brought Back).
